steps.hint: SAFETY is the panel straight ahead. Keep looking at it until the ring fills; that is how you find any panel.
Look at READY until the ring appears, then tap the screen or headset button. A tap uses whatever the ring is on.
Look at the switch until the ring appears, then tap. Each tap flips it once, and its label shows ON or OFF.
TEST DIAL is right of the switch. Each tap turns a dial one mark, so one tap moves it from 1 to 2.
CHECK TOOL is on your left. Look at it and tap; a held tool stays in your hand until you place it.

steps.instruction: Place the CHECK TOOL in the TOOL BAY.
steps.hint: TOOL BAY is on your right. Look at it while holding the tool, then tap; a tool fits only its own bay.
